name: l3-ja-reading-accuracy
metric: per-item phoneme-sequence equality after punctuation stripping (docs/evaluation.md §3)
frontend: sbv2 ja frontend (num2word → normalize → g2p), no model bundle needed

without_dictionary.non_gap: 14/14 = 1.000 (the gate: proven-correct behaviours must not regress)

closed_gaps: latin-letters: coined Latin words read letter-by-letter
with_fixture_dictionary.regressions: none — every item that passed without the dictionary still passes

gap_worklist: date-compound: '2月14日' / '2026年2月14日' → 月/年 read as つき/とし without date context (date)
colon-time: '10:30' → ':' becomes a pause; 時/分 not inferred (time)
unit-letter: '50m' → 'm' read as the letter エム (unit)
latin-letters: coined Latin words read letter-by-letter — CLOSED by the M3 dictionary layer
notes: Comparison happens at the phoneme level (mora-split both sides), so spelling variants that sound identical (ジュウ/ジュー) are equal.
Gap items are annotated with the gap field; when a fix lands, the item flips to passing and the gap field is dropped in the same PR.
The worklist is the M3+ normalization roadmap: symbol expansion (%/¥/単位) and date/time context reading are next; the dictionary layer covers coined words and user vocabulary.
